title: Making a host folder available to a container
description: Section 8, Steps 1, 2 and 4: create the folder, mount it, then write into it from inside the container and find the file on the host. The tutorial writes alpine with no tag; the recording pins alpine:3.20. The read-only check is left out because the Section 9.5 exercise asks you to paste its output yourself.

commands: docker run --rm -v "$HOME/agents/work:/work" alpine:3.20 sh -c 'ls -la /work && touch /work/hello && echo wrote'
